subject: Introduction to Medford Bites Podcast
overview: Resident Danielle Balocca introduced a new community podcast focused on Medford city government, local events, and small businesses.

items.title: Medford Bites Podcast Introduction
items.summary: Danielle Balocca introduced the 'Medford Bites' podcast as a platform for discussing local government updates, community events, and recommendations for local establishments.
